text: Long catch-up with Sinead over lunch. Her son Connor sits his driving test on 14 May, second attempt, and he's a bag of nerves. She's also been back and forth to the hospital with her dad, who had a fall last week. Remind me to text Connor good luck the night before.
Mandla rang. His mum's had the knee replacement and is home now, a bit sore but cheerful. He's taking the rest of the week off to look after her. Thabo is driving down on Saturday to help.
Yara's audition for the conservatory is June 3rd. She's been practising Rachmaninoff for months and says she can't sleep. Her girlfriend Ines is going with her for moral support.
Quick one: Ravi passed his theory test! Practical booked for 22/11.

Coffee with Ifeoma and Adaeze. Adaeze got her A level results back early and smashed it, offer from Edinburgh confirmed. Ifeoma is so proud she nearly cried. Ifeoma's off to Lagos on the 9th of December for her cousin's wedding.
Need to ring Luis the week after his surgery on 5/14 to see how he's healing.
Michael's little girl has chickenpox, so the party on Sunday is off. He sounded exhausted. Their other one, Felix, will probably get it next.
Dentist moved to 3rd Nov, 9:40. Bring the forms.

Caught up with Jakub after five a side. He's doing his ACCA exams in early December and studying every evening, so he's skipping training till they're done. His wife Katarzyna is expecting in March. Don't forget to send him a good luck message the morning of the first paper.
Zeynep's dad has been in hospital since Thursday with pneumonia. She's flying to Izmir tomorrow. I should check in with her at the weekend.
Reza mentioned his daughter is sitting her 11+ on September 14th. They've been doing practice papers every Sunday. He's more nervous than she is, honestly.
Chris Baker called about the book club. Vanessa's hosting next month, and she's gluten free, so no pastries this time. Chris has done his back in again lifting a sofa.
Remind me to ask Bogdan how his citizenship test went. It was on Monday.
Lorenzo is retaking his bar exam in February after failing by two points in July. He's gutted but determined. Lives with his brother Tariq in Clapham now. Tariq's a nurse at St Thomas'.

Jada's son Yusuf broke his wrist at football on Saturday. Cast for six weeks, which means he misses the county final on 28 Nov. Jada says he's devastated. Maybe get him a signed programme or something, he collects them.
Irina finished chemo! Final round was 10/2 and her scan is booked for Nov 18th. Her husband Aleksander has been amazing apparently. Must send flowers this week.

Long chat with Caroline. Her mum has early dementia, diagnosed in the summer, and Caroline's been driving to Leeds every weekend. Work are letting her go part time from January. She mentioned she'd love a decent travel mug for all the driving. Her sister Zara is supposed to help but has her own stuff going on, a messy divorce. I need to call Caroline next week, she sounded really low.
Thabo's grade 8 piano exam is 2 December. Don't forget to text him that evening to see how it went.
Ines got into the Royal Ballet summer school. Over the moon. Starts in July.
Mandla's twins have their first swimming gala on 16th Nov. He wants me to come. Also says Thabo's knee is still bad after the rugby, physio twice a week.

Grabbed a drink with Connor Murphy. He's been signed off work with stress for a month. Doesn't want to talk about it much. Likes hiking, mentioned the Peak District a lot. Maybe suggest a walk once he's feeling up to it.
Picked up the prescription. Still need to sort the car MOT before the 30th.

Khadija's eldest, Tariq, starts his GCSE mocks on November 24th and has decided now is the time to learn the guitar. She's tearing her hair out. Remind me the day before to send him that revision timetable app.
Luis and Ines are doing the Valencia half marathon on 6 December together. They've been training since June. Luis's calf has been playing up though.
Ricardo's little boy, Felix, was in A&E last night with a high fever. Turned out to be an ear infection, home now. Ricardo hasn't slept. Text him tomorrow to see how they're both doing.
Felix said his driving test got cancelled because of snow, rebooked for Jan 12th. He's annoyed but also secretly relieved.
Vanessa told me Sinead's dog Biscuit had to have a tooth out. Sinead's very dramatic about it.

Talked to Jack about his MSc. Dissertation hand-in is 15/09 and the viva sometime in October. His partner Michael is doing all the cooking so Jack can focus. They're off to Lisbon after it's all done.
Ravi's mum is having a cataract op on the 4th of November. He's taking her and staying over. Ask him the week after how she got on.
Zara's results day for the nursing degree is May 20th. She says she's fine but she's not fine.
Called Adaeze. Her dad's blood pressure is all over the place and they've got him on new meds. She's worried. Her brother Yusuf is coming home from Manchester for a few days.
Bogdan has his HGV test on 3rd of March. Has wanted to drive lorries since he was a kid. Wife Irina says he talks about nothing else.
Don't forget: Katarzyna's scan is Thursday at 2. She asked me to message her afterwards, she's anxious after last time.

Lunch with Yara and Jakub. Yara is starting a PGCE in September and is already stressing about placements. Jakub said his sister Zeynep just passed her driving test on the fourth try, which deserves a cake. Yara's flatmate has COVID so she's working from home this week. Yara loves anything Studio Ghibli, worth knowing for her birthday in April.
Reza's back from Tehran. His father passed away in September and the funeral was hard. He's back at work Monday but taking it slow.

Chris finally got his MRI results: torn meniscus, surgery scheduled for 7/22. Wants to be back on the bike by autumn. His wife Caroline is less optimistic and says he's already moping. Their son Jack has his driving test the same week, of course. Remind me to drop round a few days after with some food.
Felt rubbish all day. Cancelled the gym, early night.
Michael Dubois is sitting his CFA level 2 on June 1st. Third time. I should text him the day before, he goes quiet when he's stressed.
Tariq Shah, aka Taz, is auditioning for the West End run of Hamilton next Tuesday. Never seen him this nervous. His mum Khadija is coming down for it.

Jada's mum fell and broke her hip on Sunday. Surgery went fine but she'll be in hospital for at least a fortnight. Jada's juggling the kids and visiting every day. Should take her a meal at some point.
Ifeoma's daughter has a violin recital 12 Dec. She's playing a solo for the first time.
Zeynep messaged: she got the job at the hospital lab! Starts on Nov 3rd. Her mum's been unwell so the timing is good, she'll be closer to home.

Spent ages on the phone with Irina. Aleksander's mum is in a care home now after a stroke in August. He visits every Sunday and it's taking a toll. Irina thinks he should talk to someone. Their son Felix has his first university exams in January and is ignoring her texts. Remind me to message Aleksander that Sunday evening after his visit.
Lorenzo is allergic to nuts, remember for the dinner on the 8th.
Sinead says Luis is moving to Cork in spring. New job at the university there. He's thrilled.
Katarzyna's had a rough week. Morning sickness is brutal and her boss isn't being understanding. Jakub's doing his best. Should check in with her Friday.
Need to buy a card for Thabo's mum, she's in hospital again. Visiting hours are 2 to 4 on weekdays.

Caught Ricardo at the school gate. His daughter Ines passed her grade 5 ballet with distinction. His wife Vanessa had a scare with a lump but it's benign, huge relief. He's training for a triathlon in May.
Jack's mum's 70th is on the 3rd of August. He's thinking of a surprise party. She loves gardening, anything for the greenhouse.
Remind me to call Mandla the evening before his citizenship interview on November 27th.
Caroline's daughter Jada got her driving test result: passed first time! Caroline is now terrified of her taking the car.

Connor's sister has glandular fever and is missing half a term of uni. He's worried she'll have to repeat the year. Her name is Sinead, I think? Their parents are in Spain till 2/15. Connor's trying to keep her spirits up and drives over with soup every couple of days. She's meant to be sitting her second year exams in January. Ask him on Friday how she's getting on.
Booked flights for Christmas, 21 Dec out, 2 Jan back. Need to tell work.
Adaeze has her dental school interview on March 4th and second one on 3/18. I said I'd do a mock interview with her the week before.

Uncle Reza is recovering from a mild heart attack. Yusuf says he's being a terrible patient and keeps trying to mow the lawn. Yusuf is covering at the shop until mid December, and his own law exams are on 12/15, so he's stretched thin. Reza's cardiology follow-up is December 2nd. Yusuf asked if I could pop round to sit with his dad one afternoon next week.
Zara and Chris got engaged at the weekend! Wedding probably next summer. Chris's grandad is poorly so they might do something small sooner.
Bogdan's exam got moved from 14/05 to 21/05, so the leaving drinks shift too.

Ravi has a big presentation to the board on Thursday and his son's been off school with tonsillitis all week. He's running on fumes. His wife Zara's away in Dubai for work until the 30th, so he's solo parenting as well. Text him Thursday evening to see how it went.
Khadija loves bouldering and goes three times a week. Her partner Tariq is vegan. They've got a cat called Pickle.

Lorenzo and Ines are flying to Naples on 19 December for his nonna's 90th. Then he has his final exams on January 8th, poor man. He said he's bringing revision on the plane. Ines's own mum has the flu so she's not sure she can go. I should give Ines a ring next week to see if she's still going.
